purpose: Build v109 from the accepted camera and Astro mainline changes since the physically observed v108 packet, with explicit driver selection and automatic version-to-commit binding. Build-only candidate; no physical qualification is inferred.

changes.summary: daef5b7be routes held-Bulb start through the shared capture admission/recovery path instead of permanently refusing a pending prior output. Active Bulb and active transfer remain refused; production-path regressions cover these distinctions.

1bf8ba51a restricts form-less Pentax scalar controls to the IT2-source-defined UINT16 color-temperature domain (2500..10000 K, 10 K steps); unknown scalar domains are withheld. a09622106 makes exposure/processing timeout phases and existing budgets visible on stderr without widening timeouts.

4cbfcf27e propagates failed single-config getters rather than returning GP_OK with no usable widget. Tests cover unavailable controls. Consumer-only -2110 and K-3 III restore failures remain unresolved, not worked around.

Includes the Astro agent's accepted mainline work: pixel-scale index pruning (80f3ee9), shared size-aware downsample policy (08bd619), verified index downloads (4e43427), opt-in monotonic solve timings (d5f9a78), and bilinear-weight hoisting (b820b25). No additional solver-policy tuning is introduced in this camera release.

Integrates PR #346's explicit full-SHA selection and adds supplied-source pin matching, main-only Astro candidates, preflight version checks, automatic post-gate version/commit binding, and nonzero failure for missing artifacts even when the child exits zero.

Capture evidence classification recognizes -108 transfer failure despite a nearby filename; the prerelease gate includes the four previously omitted Astro suites; host re-exec tests use a temporary repo and hermetic command PATH, never real candidate log directories.

validation_focus: Clean exact-SHA direct-host driver regression suite; source/pin ancestry, shipped ARM ELF ABI/dependencies and markers; package manifests and firmwareInfo digests.
Compare shipped v109 artifacts against exact v108, including the Astro SD archives, and preserve all gate transcripts and skips.

After separate review and supported installation: exact loaded-runtime identity, K-1 II ordinary two-shot repeat, valid settings arrays, changed-value read-back and restoration, RAW+JPEG reconciliation, then bounded timed/held Bulb and cancellation with physical closure proof.

Fresh K-3 III direct-PC session must resolve the prior failed shutter restoration and USB disappearance before requalification; Canon R5 II and other previously qualified camera paths need regression hardware.
Astro real-image upload and captured-image solve timings, preview ownership, file publication, and camera/head integration remain separate end-to-end gates.
known_limits: No installation or new physical camera operation is performed by this candidate build. v108 K-1 II ordinary-capture successes are baseline evidence only, not v109 passes.

Recent v108 evidence outranks historical failures, especially pre-304 tests. K-1 II command-261 -2110, initial ordinary-capture -1005/-110, K-3 III failed shutter restoration/USB loss, true Bulb/cancel, and RAW+JPEG publication remain open.
An offline or emulator pass does not prove shutter closure, settings restoration, full camera compatibility, or OpenPolaris end-to-end behavior.
The source host gate uses Meson; shipped ARM libraries use autotools. Inspect shipped artifacts separately and record prerequisite skips.
No guessed vendor opcodes, new firmware offsets, unconditional retries, synthesized camera lists, or timeout expansion are introduced.
Independent review of exact source commits, provenance, private artifact hashes, and physical qualification is required before release-qualified status.
